mechanisticSeparation.fromScoreline: The mediator is a private player-hand liability and deterministic clean-up action; it neither reads nor damages an enemy marker.
mechanisticSeparation.fromAfterimage: The package contrast is debt creation versus debt removal. Ward is a fixed carrier anchor, not the mediator payoff, and Afterimage remains a separate fixed interference stratum.
mechanisticSeparation.fromKindle: The token is a curse, removal never calls exhaust_card and grants no Ember.
mechanisticSeparation.fromAshHandSize: The aspect-qualified mediator is inert for Ashwarden; base Attack and Ward carrier effects remain available for aspect-identity controls.
